snippet.title: FNM : MAGNIFIED (VS TORTURE) DEMO V2.1 FULL MOD SHOWCASE (OFFICIAL)
snippet.description:
Friday Night Madness: Magnified DEMO V2.1 HAS FINALLY BEEN RELEASED

DOWNLOAD THE MOD ON GAMEBANANA : https://gamebanana.com/mods/306788

Credits are in the video

after many years of puting the mod on hold and many days of time managment difficulties the mod can finally present itself as a new fresh version of the original VS TORTURE mod from 2021

PLEASE UNDERSTAND that despite it being a demo some issues may occur playing the mod if you have a weak pc (and my lack of coding knowladge)

The Story: After passing out from a certain clown's wrath, Boyfriend has been captured by the Agency Against Hank Wimbleton under Auditors command and forced to rap against the hulking beast of an agent to see if he is capable to stand his ground. Certainly a better fate than being merely stomped into a blue paste!
